item.text:
**8B.2 Research Note for Nguyễn Phú Trọng in 2024**

Bottom line: the record is mixed. There is solid evidence that the 2024 state line under Trọng was translated into concrete plans, institutions, appointments, and enforcement mechanisms. But the implementation was often party-controlled, disruptive, and after mid-July 2024 only indirectly attributable to Trọng personally.

- **Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan** | Government of Viet Nam | 2024-01-08 | https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm | The government set 2024 priorities around macroeconomic stability, inflation control, active monetary and fiscal policy, and legislative/institutional reform tied to the state budget. This is direct evidence of a governing program being turned into concrete priorities and policy sequencing. | `8B.2`, `8B.1`

- **Plan for implementing the Social Insurance Law 2024** | Viet Nam Social Security | 2024-11-26 | https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375 | The social security sector created a steering group, assigned agency responsibilities, set a national roadmap, and ordered inspection, guidance, and problem-solving for implementation. This is strong evidence of translation into timelines, institutions, and enforcement mechanisms. | `8B.2`, `7B.10`

- **Audit standards of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam 2024** | State Audit Office of Viet Nam | 2024 | https://sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=261&l=News | The audit office issued 43 standards covering financial, compliance, and performance audits, with explicit emphasis on professionalism, honesty, objectivity, openness, and public trust. This is concrete institutionalization, not just rhetoric. | `8B.2`, `7B.10`

- **Audit oversight and enforcement resolution** | Chính phủ Việt Nam / National Assembly mirror | 2024-07-16 | https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/nghi-quyet-so-141-2024-qh15-ve-hoat-dong-chat-van-tai-ky-hop-thu-7-quoc-hoi-khoa-xv-119240716155719243.htm | The resolution calls for revising audit law and procedures, focusing audits on sensitive issues, publicizing audit results, tracking compliance, and disciplining weak or improper audit work. That is a clear enforcement architecture, not a vague commitment. | `8B.2`, `7B.10`

- **Vietnam names acting president after legislature votes to remove Thuong** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-21 | https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-names-acting-president-after-legislature-votes-to-remove-thuong/2009559/ | The leadership removed a top official amid the anti-graft campaign and appointed an acting president through formal constitutional procedure. This shows Trọng’s program being converted into personnel control and disciplinary enforcement. | `8B.2`, `7B.10`, `8B.1`

- **Vietnam Communist Party names police minister as state president / To Lam takes top job** | Reuters via ThePrint / ReutersFeed | 2024-05-18 and 2024-08-03 | https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-communist-party-names-police-minister-as-state-president/2091207/ and https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-president-to-lam-takes-top-job-as-communist-party-chief/2205833/ | The anti-graft drive produced further leadership turnover, with To Lam elevated first to president and then to party chief. This is concrete appointment-based enforcement, but it also shows the program ran through elite reshuffling rather than stable institutionalization alone. | `8B.2`, `7B.10`, `8B.1`

- **Vietnam minister says president's resignation has not affected policies** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-26 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681 | The foreign minister said policy continuity rested on collective leadership, not one individual, and that the anti-corruption drive was consistent with existing policy. This is moderate evidence of an explicit governing model, though it is institutional rather than personally Trọng-authored. | `8B.2`, `8B.1`

- **Vietnam's anti-graft campaign caused administrative paralysis** | Reuters via ThePrint / Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-05-17 and 2024-05-20 | https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/ and https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/ | Reuters reported delayed approvals, lost aid, upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy. This is the strongest counterevidence: the program was real, but its translation into administration was politically disruptive and often brittle. | `8B.2`

- **Trọng’s duties were transferred on July 18 because of illness** | Reuters via ThePrint / Government of Viet Nam | 2024-07-18 to 2024-07-19 | https://en.baochinhphu.vn/politburo-issues-notice-on-party-general-secretarys-health-111240718161208612.htm and https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/ | By mid-July, effective day-to-day control had already shifted away from Trọng. That limits how confidently late-2024 implementation can be attributed to him personally, even if the institutional program continued. | `8B.2`

Search gap: I did not find a single Trọng-authored 2024 master plan with line-item budgets and deadlines spanning the whole agenda. The evidence is dispersed across government resolutions, sector implementation plans, audit rules, and Reuters reporting on appointments and reshuffles.
